Delivering impact and engaging local communities in ATX.
Jak and Mari joined @longhornracing at @UTAustin for a Q&A and to tour their garage, giving the aspiring engineers first-hand insight into the Formula One world.
detailZh:
在ATX地区产生影响力并吸引当地社区参与。
Jak和Mari加入了@longhornracing，在@UTAustin进行了一场问答活动并参观了他们的车库，为有抱负的工程师们提供了Formula One世界的第一手资料。
detailEn:
